The menu

A selection from the delivery menu the tavern keeps on foody.com.cy, prices in euro including VAT. For most main dishes this is the starting price, the plate costs more with a bigger fish. Almost everything comes with chips or rice and a village salad, the grilled dishes with lemon oil. Most ordered there: grilled boat squid, fried calamari rings and grilled sea bream.

From the tables

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

Across the road from the sea

Stefanos Fish Tavern stands on Piale Pasa in Larnaca, on the stretch towards Mackenzie, with the promenade and the water directly across the road. The terrace has light blue chairs, white tablecloths and a view over the bay. On the plates: sea bream, sea bass and swordfish from the charcoal, boat squid, octopus and shrimps, fried calamari and small crabs, and the platters that guests mention most often. With 1,212 Google reviews and 4.1 stars, meze, platter and sea view are the three words that come up again and again.

Open Tuesday to Sunday from eleven in the morning until eleven at night, Monday closed. Eat in, take away or order delivery. The tavern answers its Google reviews itself, the good ones and the critical ones.

What guests say

Two of 1,212 Google reviews, 4.1 stars on average.

“We had an amazing dinner at Stefanos Tavern. Friendly staff and very attentive. great atmosphere on the terrace. They have a great variety of platters and fresh fish. We had a grilled seabass which was absolutely amazing. This was one of the best dinners in Larnaca”
Irina Stanici · Google review
“Great value for your money. Great atmosphere, full of locals. Welcoming staff. The platter if seafood comes with lots of appetizers which we were not expecting. All tasty :). At the end we also got tasty watermelon.”
Cristina P · Google review
